traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Limit meets power. Hard discipline, endurance under heavy pressure, real consequences, and control. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Strict accountability and early, immediate retribution; severity and rigidity. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for limit against power, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the limit/power form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Able to carry punishing, transformative work; the risk is harshness.
shadow: Fear and rigidity collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
